_comment: Editions listed in 'published' are built into data/v1 and offered by the app. Editions in 'held' stay out of data/v1 (they can only be built locally with --all --out).

held_reasons.ara-*1: Arabic 'diacritics removed' editions: the text differs from the diacritized edition (different, unstated source) and they would appear as a second Arabic text. Not offered for now.

publication_basis: The owner decided (2026-10-15) to rely on the upstream project's Unlicense for the translations. The upstream author states the translations come from third-party websites (see upstream/References.md) and most translators are 'Unknown'; no permission from those sources is documented. Removal requests are handled as described in TAKEDOWN.md.
